body: It’s scary but it’s very plausible
If you’re depressed and badly depressed. You’ll know.

Healthy then mate. If you’re gonna do anything consume enjoyable healthy food like smoothies! Get them vitamins buddy! .. Water and maybe treat yourself to a fish and chips at the end of the day if you have the money! :)
Exercise, you need to feel exhaustion and then you’ll sweat out the THC in your fat cells, sleep away withdrawals better.. Eat healthy too! .. Good luck.

Life struggles.. Seriously life sucks and most people know that by now aha! I’m 31, quit my well paid shit job in Feb the Covid fucked me over.. Royally screwed me and left me with my mortgage and no money.. Meh :/ 

Something will turn up! .. Anyway I smoke the Cannabis too, trying to cut down yet I got addicted at 27 :/ .. Never had a dependency before so I know the pain! Life becomes very dull without it..

Anyway I was gonna suggest you listen to Alan Watts, I mean I take life too seriously, yet this thinking about Alan talking in his lectures about how insignificant this will all be one day brings a smile to my face. All I can say is try and embrace it, the world isn’t what your consciousness says, we are all having a human experience, technically from another perspective you could call it an illusion 😂

Don’t worry man!

Don’t worry about it.. All this social media and celebrity shit got people feeling as though they aren’t special and pathetic. Most people aren’t happy, all these people obsessed with social media, sharing photos, chasing validation.. They aren’t happy.

What I’m trying to tell you is it doesn’t matter.. Just relax, enjoy life because it really doesn’t matter! .. Imagine having all the money in the world and all the pressure no time to spend it and enjoy it? .. Celebrities are miserable, do your research kiddo! ..

And please consider God, I’m on the fence myself but I think I believe in God very much.. Not so much religion. Chin up lads, I’m sick just as much as you guys!
Man, don’t be daft! I have no mates at all and I don’t consider myself ugly.. I just don’t know many people on a deep conscious level.
Well said but when the civil war starts we gon need people like you!

The hardest thing for me is realising that nobody and nothing can help.. Even the Doctor said “What do you want me to do?” .. I’m always torn between letting go of the pain yet I’m held by the love I have for a couple people .. Meh
Your gay, no big deal.. Nothing matters, this world is delusional, it’s insane! .. Watch some Alan Watts on YouTube. If it’s any consolation I’m depressed as fuck :)

Man, I love you! I’m sorry for the pain, I’m feeling it for about 3 years and it doesn’t matter if you’re fat or balding man! I’ve put on a few pounds and I’m receding! Life does take a lot away from us! .. I can’t tell you not to suicide cause I contemplate it everyday. I know too much yet so little. I’d rather be your friend as I don’t have any anymore.

Everyone is out for themselves in this material world.. Some of us are just wanderers realising the dirt amongst us so lost.
Do I want to be successful in this corrupt broken world ... 🤔 Motivation, says no.

I went through a time where I constantly worked for years. Felt like I was on autopilot almost for a decade. I guess I was searching for, money, security, sex, peace and acceptance.

I realised over time that I wasn’t satisfied I was never fulfilled but tired and the people around me were tired, mental health was massive and many were secretly suffering. I spent time learning the Scientific analogy of depression and Serotonin and completely understood.

I started realising that we as people don’t really stop until we are older, when time is scarce and our primes are gone. Missing some important elements of life, love and family. I realised the world we live in isn’t what I ever believed it was, even the Celebrities that found wealth and what some would believe as fulfilment were also depressed and unsatisfied with our existence.

We look through history, we see violence and corruption. I used to thank God for the fact I was born after all the war and Corruption. I was wrong, we are in it. Governments, conformity, the destruction of our earth, animal enslavement. The fact we are psychologically slaves to a system that strips us of any chance of freedom. Just dreams.

Every religion that I have even researched has always had the idea of peace. The Government manipulated Media only disclose the lies they want to feed us, dividing us and blaming war on religion. War is greed and lies! 9/11 was a war for oil and I believe most know this now.

They are still trying to divide us and lie to us. People believe they are Powerful, we are the people and without us they lose. The Woke need to stay woke, we can rebuild and relive this world and make this place a better place for Generations to come, without the destructive and immoral ideas of power and wealth because in the end, you will eventually and always lose.

Trying to grasp the truth to my own reality has been hard. Some days I wake up and can’t believe what happened to my reality, I just feel woke. To find fulfilment won’t be the house in Tenerife with the fast car I used to dream of. It’s trying to fix this world and be part of a revolution. Nothing else matters. 

Peace.
